title: AlphaFrog gray rules document v1
description: Schema version v1 for gray-rules.json. ruleVersion is the configuration propagation and audit version; it is not the schema version and never participates in bucketing.

ruleVersion.description: Configuration propagation and audit identifier. It is logged after a successful atomic load and never enters the bucket hash.

bucketSalt.description: Document-wide bucket salt. Changing it intentionally reassigns every rule's buckets. Colons are forbidden so the v1 concatenation remains unambiguous.

rules.description: Complete rule set replaced atomically after the whole document passes structural and semantic validation.

ruleId.description: Stable identifier used by business code. It must also be unique within the rules array; uniqueness by ruleId is a semantic check outside JSON Schema draft-07.

enabled.description: Emergency off switch. false takes precedence over userFilter and percent.

percent.description: A non-allowlisted user matches when its stable bucket number is strictly less than percent.

userFilter.description: Exact-match user identifiers that take precedence over percent after enabled, expiry, and non-empty user checks.

owner.description: Accountable maintainer for the rule. Loaders must additionally reject an all-whitespace value.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 instant with an explicit UTC offset. At now >= expiresAt, the rule is treated as disabled but remains stored for audit.
